response_text: The OS would still work with a single thread. This is because once the print_continiously thread yielded to the OS, the scheduler would start the next thread in the queue to run and reschedule the current thread. However, since there is only no other threads, the only one present in the queue would be print_continiously which has been rescheduled. As a result print_continiously would run continuously which is equivalent to the behaviour when not running multiple threads.\n
